title: ID0419060-DC/Si-D/FI-[zdOKrA]-Suomussalmi no sessions on DC2 after 29.3.
description:
Customer complaint there has not been any session on right DC2 outlet but there has been OCPP “preparing” messages coming through. From AWS we can confirm last succesful session was 29.3.2025.
Cable broken, bad contact or broken EcoG?
Markus will update version from 6.0.3 to 6.1.3 asap
Cable internally broken. CP pin shows 0VDC while wire terminal block shows 12.2VDC. Cable replaced.
